newsitem.title: USA: ARXA gains Louisiana oil-drilling stakes.
newsitem.headline: ARXA gains Louisiana oil-drilling stakes.

text.p: ARXA International Energy Inc said Tuesday it has acquired a 12.5 percent working interest in the Northwest Hackberry Producing Area and a 12.5 percent working interest in the West Hackberry Field, both in Cameron Parish, La.

The acquisitions, which were made for an undisclosed amount of cash, give ARXA participation in redrilling of a previously abandoned well in a producing area and in an offset well slated to be drilled in February 1997, it said.
It said Northwest Hackberry is currently producing a total of about 25 barrels of oil per day.

ARXA said it will participate in "twinning" a discovery well drilled in the area, explaining the well to be started in about two weeks replaces a well that found, cored and tested a new 50-foot oil sand, but could not be completed due to mechanical problems.
It said a West Hackberry Field offset well will be drilled in February, adding there is room for six additional development wells in the field.
